## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D incremental game called for a flourishing omnidirectional tree with about 60 upgrade nodes, suited for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Node categories: tap multipliers, upgrade multipliers, auto buyers, auto taps, speedups, and rebirths.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots using small JPEGs at viewport widths no greater than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game named Verdant with a 61-node tree, idle progression, saving, offline growth, and rebirth bonuses.
- Used Three.js from a CDN for the 3D tree, with a 2D canvas fallback if the 3D engine fails.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` implementing the game and responsive layouts.
- Verified `node --check game.js` passes.
- Tested tapping, selecting a tree node, and purchasing it in Playwright.
- Captured and inspected desktop and mobile JPEG screenshots.

### Active
- Fixing the mobile header/rail layout after the mobile screenshot showed resource and tap controls overlapping; added `mobile-fix.css` and linked it in `index.html`, but have not re-captured or checked the result.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-capture and inspect the mobile screenshot after the `mobile-fix.css` changes.
2. Check for remaining UI or gameplay issues, then report assumptions and completion to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game structure and module entry point.
- `game.js`: Game logic, 61-node tree, Three.js rendering, save and offline progression.
- `style.css`: Main visual styles and responsive layouts.
- `mobile-fix.css`: Recent mobile grid placement overrides.
- `screenshots/verdant.jpg`: Desktop screenshot.
- `screenshots/verdant-mobile.jpg`: Earlier mobile screenshot, before the CSS fix.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local test server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002` under tmux session `verdant`.
- Playwright showed only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL software-rendering warnings; Three.js rendered.
- The mobile screenshot revealed the tap control overlaying the resource card; the new CSS override has not yet been verified.
